content_data.meeting_title: Network Security Architecture Review - 5G Core Implementation
agenda_items: Evaluate multi-tenant isolation strategy for regional carrier deployments
Review current authentication protocol implementation for 5G standalone core
key_decisions: Implement hardware security module integration for cryptographic key management before regional rollout
Mandate code signing and artifact verification in CI/CD pipeline starting next sprint
Adopt TLS 1.3 with mutual authentication for all inter-service communication within the next 4 weeks
attendees: Lena Kowalski, Principal Engineer - Network Functions
